introHtml: Direct-to-film (DTF) decoration allows full-color, high-detail prints on medical healthcare items such as lab coats, scrubs, and tote bags. Unlike standard embroidery or screen printing, DTF transfers produce soft-hand prints with no raised texture, ideal for items that need to feel smooth against the skin. This method is especially suited for bulk orders of custom medical gear where crisp logos, small text, or photographic images are required without compromising comfort or durability.
